status: validated; purchases use true GA4 Purchases metric (overall_funnel.purchase and adnoc_funnel.purchase remain funnel-step completion counts, unchanged)
data_quality_note: Desktop users jumped to 4,399 on 30 Jul, well above the recent daily range of roughly 1,200-1,400 (mobile 7,420 and tablet 37 stayed within normal range); Direct channel also rose sharply to 7,806 vs a recent daily range of 4,975-6,002. Both increases coincided with a Total Users rise (+17.6% vs 29 Jul) even though Funnel Entrants fell (-7.8%), so the extra traffic did not translate into more funnel activity. Reported as observed, not corrected or estimated, and flagged as a possible tracking or bot-traffic anomaly requiring investigation. Device totals (11,856) and channel totals (11,825) for this date each differ slightly from the reported Total Users (11,864); this is normal GA4 cross-dimension user overlap, not a data error.
